blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Using 10 stories or 12 stories as the accelerograph threshold. The code specifies 14 stories minimum, not 10 or 12.","Specifying only 2 accelerographs. The code requires at least 3: basement, mid-height, roof. All three are needed to capture the building's response.","Treating accelerograph maintenance as a one-time commissioning task. Maintenance is continuous and is the owner's responsibility for the life of the building.","Using I = 1.0 for essential facilities. Essential facilities MUST use I = 1.25. This is not negotiable and is not optional.","Confusing I = 1.25 (essential facility) with I = 1.5 (other codes or contexts). The NSCP specifies I = 1.25 for essential facilities, not 1.5.","Thinking accelerographs are optional or decorative. They are code-mandated equipment in tall buildings and serve critical roles in validation and future design updates."]} />
